summary: Fixed the last open instance of T35 F-005 in src/flow/service.ts's flow-completion gate: the catch arms around the health and security gates recorded status:"skipped" when the gate's evaluation threw, and gates.every((gate) => gate.status !== "fail") treats skipped as non-blocking, so an exception in either gate was indistinguishable from a pass and let the flow complete. Both catch arms now push a new shared unevaluableGate(name) helper that returns status:"fail" with a constant, leak-safe detail naming only the gate -- the thrown error text is never interpolated, closing the second half of F-005 (a caught error carrying a path or file content into flow.json history and buildIssueComment). All six gate producers in complete() were read end to end before choosing scope: gates 1 (acceptance-criteria) and 4 (review) already push status:"fail" from their catch arms and were left untouched (conservative, out of this task's named regression, though their detail strings still leak error.message -- flagged as a concern, not fixed); the pull-request-gate's tracker-unavailable skip and the tasks-gate's per-package opt-out skip are genuine non-throw skip paths and are untouched; the security gate's module-disabled omission (deps.securityGate undefined) is a separate if-guard, not a catch arm, and is untouched. Two new regression tests (one per fixed arm) plant a secret-looking path in the thrown Error and assert the gate blocks and the detail excludes it; both were RED before the fix (status "skipped" observed) and GREEN after. Full src/flow/ suite: 183 pass / 0 fail.

acceptance.criterion: A gate that cannot be evaluated blocks flow completion instead of being recorded as skipped, and its detail is a constant that names the gate without echoing raw error text, a path or source bytes.
acceptance.evidence: New regression tests in src/flow/security-gate.test.ts and src/flow/service.test.ts throw an Error containing a planted path (/Users/attacker/.ssh/id_rsa) and 'ENOENT' from securityGate/healthGate respectively. Pre-fix (RED, plain `bun test` with file args, console captured in T45-implementation.md): both failed with Expected "fail" / Received "skipped". Post-fix (GREEN): bun src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun test src/flow/security-gate.test.ts src/flow/service.test.ts -> 13 pass / 0 fail / 64 expect() (raw .metaproject/data/gdctx/raw/2026-09-06T14-57-26-647Z_run.log). Both gates now assert status==="fail", detail excludes both the planted path and "ENOENT", result.passed===false, result.flow.status==="in-progress".

acceptance.criterion: A gate omitted because its module is disabled, and a genuinely skipped optional check, both keep their current behavior; no flow that legitimately completes today stops completing.
acceptance.evidence: Enumerated all six gate producers in complete() before editing (table in T45-implementation.md). Untouched and re-verified green: 'no securityGate dep: no security gate runs (no regression)' and 'securityGate returning null omits the gate entirely' (module-disabled omission, an if-guard not a catch arm); the pull-request gate's tracker-unavailable status:"skipped" path (unrelated code, no try/catch); taskGate's gates.tasks-disabled status:"skipped" path (free-standing function, no try/catch); 'advisory securityGate adds an informational passing gate' and 'enforced securityGate failure returns the flow to in-progress' (real reported pass/fail from the gate, not a throw -- unaffected by the constant-detail change, which only fires on an exception). Full src/flow/ suite (183 tests across 20 files) and the sibling review/task-gate suites (81 tests across 3 files) both 0 fail. The happy-path and gate-failure-path tests in service.test.ts, which assert exact gate name/status arrays through the full completion pipeline, are unchanged and still pass.

acceptance.criterion: Regressions fail before the change and pass after, and the flow and security focused suites stay green.
acceptance.evidence: Regressions RED before / GREEN after, confirmed by direct execution (see criterion 1). Flow-focused suites green: security-gate.test.ts + service.test.ts 13/13 (raw 2026-09-06T14-57-26-647Z_run.log); review-gate.test.ts + review-gate.e2e.test.ts + task-gate.test.ts 81/81 (raw 2026-09-06T14-57-47-881Z_run.log); full src/flow/ 183/183 (raw 2026-09-06T14-58-19-168Z_run.log). The dispatch-required security suite is NOT fully green: bun src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun test src/security/guard.test.ts -> 31 pass / 1 fail (raw 2026-09-06T14-58-24-172Z_run.log), and bun run typecheck also fails (raw 2026-09-06T14-58-53-075Z_run.log). Both failures are entirely inside src/security/guard.test.ts and src/security/persistence-sinks.test.ts (missing bytesPreserved/redaction fields on prepareOutputForPersistence's return type) -- files this task's constraints forbid editing and which git diff --stat shows already modified (~270/~480 lines) by the concurrent worker who owns src/security/guard.ts and its tests, before this task started. Zero errors or failures reference src/flow/*. Marked partial rather than met because 'security focused suite stays green' is literally not true right now, though the cause and the fix are outside this task's ownership.

artifacts.summary: Gate enumeration, the scope decision (fix only the two skipped-on-throw catch arms, leave the two already-fail arms alone), the shared-helper design, and the verification plan, written before any code change.

Full gate-by-gate enumeration table with producer/exception-path/skip-path columns, the conservatism argument for what was left untouched, the fix description, RED/GREEN transcripts, and every verification command with raw log paths.

changed_files.change: Replaced the health gate's and the security gate's catch arms (previously status:"skipped" with error.message interpolated into detail) with calls to a new unevaluableGate(name: "health" | "security") helper that returns status:"fail" with a constant detail naming only the gate. Added the helper function, placed above taskGate. No other gate, no type, no dependency signature changed.

Added regression test 'securityGate that throws blocks completion, not skips it, and never echoes the thrown text' -- plants a secret-looking path in a thrown Error and asserts status:"fail", detail excludes the planted path, result.passed===false, flow stays in-progress.

Added regression test 'healthGate that throws blocks completion, not skips it, and never echoes the thrown text' -- same shape as above, for the health gate, driven through the full init->freeze->start->taskDone->implemented->acConfirm->complete pipeline already used by the other tests in this file.
